app.reset.confirm: Start over? This clears characters, titles and the game log. Game settings (expansions, modules, ending, variants) are kept.
app.footer: Unofficial fan-made companion for Battlestar Galactica: The Board Game, not affiliated with Fantasy Flight Games. All data stays on this device.
character.gaius.note1: Receives 2 Loyalty cards at setup; adds 1 extra “Not a Cylon” card to the deck.
character.helo.note1: Starts the game “Stranded” (not on a ship).
character.apollo.note1: Starts in a viper launched from the Reserves.
character.boomer.note1: Adds 1 extra “Not a Cylon” card to the Loyalty deck.
character.boomer.note2: Receives 2 Loyalty cards in the Sleeper Agent phase.
character.samuel.note1: “Starts on the Bench”: skips Receive Skills on his first turn.
character.tom-alt.note1: “Disreputable”: draws a Mutiny card at setup (and when chosen after an execution).
loyalty.error.oneLeader: Only one player may choose a Cylon Leader.
loyalty.error.leaderNotIn3: Cylon Leaders cannot be used in a 3 player game (needs 4-7 players).
loyalty.error.countWithLeader: With a Cylon Leader the game needs 4-7 players (including the Leader).
loyalty.error.count: The game needs 3-6 players (7 only with a Cylon Leader).
loyalty.extra.sympatheticMotive: Keep the Motive deck and the Infiltration card ready for the Sympathetic Cylon.
loyalty.extra.sympatheticAgenda: Keep the Sympathetic Agenda cards (Caprica Six on the back) and the Infiltration card ready.
loyalty.extra.noSympathizerResources: No Sympathizer: set resources to 8 fuel, 7 food, 9 morale, 10 population.
loyalty.extra.noSympathizerSkills: No Sympathizer: revealed Cylons draw 3 Skill cards instead of 2.
loyalty.extra.leaderSympatheticAgenda: Cylon Leader: deal 1 random Sympathetic Agenda card (Caprica Six on the back).
loyalty.extra.leaderHostileAgenda: Cylon Leader: deal 1 random Hostile Agenda card (Centurion on the back).
loyalty.extra.leaderMotives: Cylon Leader: deal 2 random Motive cards now, and 2 more at the Sleeper Agent phase.
loyalty.extra.leaderSkills: Cylon Leader draws 2 Skill cards at start (instead of 3) unless starting as an Infiltrator.
loyalty.extra.motiveDeckTreachery: Motive deck: remove “Make an Ally”, then remove 1 random card of the 7 with Cylon allegiance.
loyalty.extra.motiveDeck: Motive deck: remove “Make an Ally” and “Fight with Honor”.
loyalty.extra.mutineer: If the Mutineer is still in the deck after the Sleeper Agent phase, the current player picks a human to draw 1 more Loyalty card.

checklist.main.resourcesNoSympathizer: Resources: 8 fuel, 7 food, 9 morale, 10 population (No Sympathizer variant).
checklist.main.ships: Ships: 1 basestar + 3 raiders in front of Galactica, 2 vipers below (launch tube areas), 2 civilian ships behind.
checklist.main.reserves: Vipers and raptors in the Reserves, fleet marker on the start of the jump track.
checklist.main.skillDecks: Skill decks by the board, each with its own face-up discard pile.
checklist.main.destiny: Destiny deck: 2 of each Skill type{treachery}, shuffled.
checklist.main.overlay: Cover the Cylon Locations with a Cylon Locations overlay (from Pegasus or Daybreak).

checklist.pegasus.board: Pegasus board to the right of the main board; Pegasus damage tokens.
checklist.pegasus.skillsDaybreak: Add the new Skill cards but NOT the Pegasus Treachery cards (Daybreak’s are used).
checklist.pegasus.skills: Add the new Skill cards, including the Reckless Treachery cards.
checklist.pegasus.cards: Add the new Crisis, Destination, Quorum, Super Crisis and Loyalty cards.
checklist.pegasus.scar: Scar token with the Cylon ships.
checklist.exodus.title: Exodus
checklist.exodus.crisisWithCag: Add all new Crisis/Super Crisis cards, including “CAG Chooses”.
checklist.exodus.crisis: Add the new Crisis/Super Crisis cards, except those that say “CAG Chooses”.
checklist.exodus.cards: Add the new Quorum, Skill and Destination cards.
checklist.exodus.nuke: Put the 3rd nuke token by the board (Admiral still starts with 2; nukes are discarded, not removed).
checklist.cylonFleet.title: Cylon Fleet board
checklist.cylonFleet.removeAttacks: Remove ALL Cylon Attack cards from the Crisis and Super Crisis decks, and the “Mining Asteroid” destination.
checklist.cylonFleet.board: Cylon Fleet board to the left of the main board, pursuit marker on Start.
checklist.cylonFleet.vipers: Remove 2 regular vipers; put the 4 Mark VII vipers in the Damaged Vipers box.
checklist.cylonFleet.admiral: Use the Exodus Admiral title card (new nuke rules){newCaprica}.
checklist.cylonFleet.admiralNewCaprica: together with the New Caprica Admiral card
checklist.daybreak.title: Daybreak
checklist.daybreak.overlays: Colonial One overlay and Daybreak Cylon Locations overlay (destroyed sides face down).
checklist.daybreak.assaultRaptor: 1 assault raptor in the Reserves, the rest by the board.
checklist.daybreak.skillsPegasus: Add the new Skill cards incl. Daybreak Treachery; remove the Pegasus Treachery cards.
checklist.daybreak.skills: Add the new Skill cards incl. the Mutiny Treachery cards.
checklist.daybreak.demetrius: Demetrius board left of the main board (room for the Rebel Basestar); shuffle the Mission deck.

checklist.ending.newcaprica.objective: Give the New Caprica objective card to the Admiral.
checklist.ending.newcaprica.titles: Use the New Caprica President and Admiral title cards.

checklist.ending.ioniannebula.objective: Give the Ionian Nebula objective card to the Admiral.

checklist.ending.ioniannebula.allies: Place Allies until 3 are on the board (skip duplicates of chosen characters), each with a face-down Trauma token.
checklist.ending.searchforhome.objective: Give the Earth objective card to the Admiral.
checklist.ending.searchforhome.demetrius: Demetrius board left of the main board; shuffle the Mission deck.

checklist.allySeasons.draw: Each player draws 4 Trauma tokens and puts 1 into the Mood Pool.

checklist.characters.skills: Every player except the first draws 3 Skill cards from their skill set.

titles.mutineer.give: {name} receives the Mutineer card (strips their titles)
titles.callout.noCharacters: No characters chosen yet, showing the full lines of succession.
titles.callout.notStarted: Game not started, showing who would get each title.
titles.give.title: Give {title} to {name} (e.g. via a card effect)
titles.rules.title: Title rules
titles.rules.passDown: Titles pass down the line automatically when a holder reveals as a Cylon (or, for Admiral, goes to the Brig). They never move just because someone higher in line becomes available - use “give” for card effects.
titles.rules.passDownCag: Titles pass down the line automatically when a holder reveals as a Cylon (or, for Admiral/CAG, goes to the Brig). They never move just because someone higher in line becomes available - use “give” for card effects.
titles.rules.humansOnly: Only human players hold titles. A revealed Cylon loses all titles to the highest in each line.
titles.rules.leadersNever: Cylon Leaders never hold titles, even while Infiltrating.
titles.rules.brig: Admiral in the Brig loses the title to the highest in line not in the Brig. They don’t get it back on release. If everyone is in the Brig, the highest in line holds it until someone leaves.
titles.rules.brigCag: Admiral and CAG in the Brig lose the title to the highest in line not in the Brig. They don’t get it back on release. If everyone is in the Brig, the highest in line holds it until someone leaves.
titles.rules.presidentBrig: The President keeps the title in the Brig.
titles.rules.detention: Detention on New Caprica does not strip the Admiral.
titles.rules.detentionCag: Detention on New Caprica does not strip the Admiral or CAG.
titles.rules.executed: Executed human: titles go to the first in line, including the new character. Other holders keep theirs.
titles.rules.mutineer: Receiving the Mutineer card strips all titles (to the highest in line, excluding the Mutineer) - tap “Mutineer” on that player. A Mutineer who reveals as a Cylon hands the card to a human player.
titles.rules.travel: Quorum hand, nukes and destination cards travel with the title.
log.mutineerHandOff: {name} must hand the Mutineer card to a human player
combat.raider.note1: Viper, assault raptor or Galactica (Weapons Control) all use the same roll.
combat.scar.note1: Only destroyed by a die roll of 7-8 (modifiers count, e.g. Strategic Planning).
combat.scar.note2: Cannot be chosen for “destroy a raider” effects without a roll (incl. Kat’s Hot Shot).
combat.centurion.note1: Centurions do not push each other on the Boarding Party track.
combat.basestar.note1: Destroyed at 3 damage. Draw a damage token per hit (Critical Hit counts as 2).
combat.basestar.note2: Structural Damage token: +2 to rolls attacking this basestar.
combat.nuke.area: Attack a space area with a nuke
combat.nuke.note1: Admiral’s title card action; the Admiral starts with 2 nukes.
combat.pegasus.note1: When Galactica is damaged, the current player may damage Pegasus instead.
combat.pegasus.note2: Destroyed when all 4 locations are damaged; characters aboard go to Sickbay.
combat.viper.note1: Damaged → Damaged Vipers box. Pilot goes to Sickbay if damaged or destroyed.
combat.viper7.note1: Moves 2 space areas instead of 1. Starts the game damaged.
combat.assault.note1: Never damaged: “damage a viper” on an assault raptor destroys it.
combat.civilian.note1: Flip the tile and lose the resources shown.

combat.basestar.ionianToken: A basestar with 2 damage that is damaged again still draws a token before it is destroyed.
combat.basestar.noToken: No token is drawn when a basestar with 2 damage is damaged again.
combat.galactica.damage: Draw a Galactica damage token: a location token damages that location (characters there go to Sickbay); a resource token means lose 1 of it. 6 damaged locations destroy Galactica - the humans lose.
combat.hint: Tap a unit for die strips and details. Rolls can’t be modified above 8 or below 1.
combat.activate.title: Activate a viper
combat.activate.launch: Launch a viper from the Reserves into an area with a viper launch icon.
combat.activate.moveMk7: Move to an adjacent area (Mark VII vipers move two areas).
combat.activate.attack: Attack a Cylon ship in the same area (roll on the table above).
combat.activate.escort: Escort a civilian ship in its area to safety - shuffle it back into the unused civilian ships.
combat.activate.pilot: A piloted viper is only activated by its pilot (as their action). Unmanned vipers are activated by e.g. Command or cards.
combat.after.title: After combat
combat.after.human: Destroyed human ships are removed from the game; a pilot goes to Sickbay.
combat.after.cylon: Destroyed Cylon ships just return to the supply.
combat.after.evasive: Evasive Maneuvers only works when a viper is attacked, not other damage.
combat.after.assault: Assault raptors attack like vipers and may stay in space when the fleet jumps.
crisis.raiders.name: Activate Raiders
crisis.raiders.intro: Each raider on the main board activates once (one space area at a time, current player picks the order). Each raider does the first possible:
crisis.raiders.step1: Attack an unmanned viper in its area
crisis.raiders.step2: Attack a manned viper in its area
crisis.raiders.step3: Destroy a civilian ship in its area
crisis.raiders.step4: Move 1 area toward the nearest civilian ship (ties: clockwise)
crisis.raiders.step5: No civilians anywhere: attack Galactica (8 = damage)
crisis.raiders.outro: No raiders on the board → each basestar launches 2 raiders.
crisis.launch.name: Launch Raiders
crisis.launch.does: Each basestar on the main board launches 3 raiders into its own space area.
crisis.launch.exception: If the only basestar on the main board has a Disabled Hangar token, no basestar is placed and the Pursuit track does not advance.
crisis.heavy.name: Activate Heavy Raiders (and Centurions)
crisis.heavy.step1: Every Centurion moves 1 step on the Boarding Party track
crisis.heavy.step2: Heavy raiders already in an area with a viper launch icon → replaced by a Centurion at the track start
crisis.heavy.step3: Other heavy raiders move 1 area toward the nearest launch icon
crisis.heavy.step4: No heavy raiders on the board at the start → each basestar launches 1 heavy raider
crisis.heavy.none: No basestars, heavy raiders or Centurions
crisis.basestars.name: Activate Basestars
crisis.basestars.does: Each basestar on the main board attacks Galactica (4-8 = damage). Disabled Weapons tokens stop a basestar firing.
crisis.basestars.doesPegasus: Each basestar on the main board attacks Galactica (4-8 = damage); the current player may let Pegasus take the damage instead. Disabled Weapons tokens stop a basestar firing.
crisis.basestars.exception: If the only basestar on the main board has a Disabled Weapons token, no basestar is placed and the Pursuit track does not advance.
crisis.resolution.title: Crisis card resolution
crisis.resolution.resolveAttack: Resolve it: Cylon Attack, Skill Check{reckless}, or “[Someone] Chooses” event.
crisis.resolution.resolve: Resolve it: Skill Check{reckless}, or “[Someone] Chooses” event.
crisis.resolution.activate: Activate Cylon ships shown bottom-left (left to right if several).
crisis.resolution.jump: Prepare for Jump icon bottom-right → advance the jump track 1 space (may trigger a jump).
crisis.resolution.discard: Discard the Crisis unless told to keep it.
crisis.mode.fleet: Cylon Fleet board in use: ships always activate on the main board, but when there is nothing to activate a ship is placed on the Cylon Fleet board instead.
crisis.mode.noFleet: No Cylon Fleet board: new ships only come in via Cylon Attack cards, launches, and location/card effects, all on the main board. With nothing to activate, nothing happens.
crisis.reckless.title: Reckless Skill Checks
crisis.reckless.where: Where it happens in the Skill Check
crisis.icons.title: Activation icons
crisis.fallback.question: {none}?
crisis.fallback.place: Place {ship} on the Cylon Fleet board (see below).
crisis.jump.name: Prepare for Jump
crisis.jump.does: Advance the fleet token 1 space on the jump track. At Auto-Jump the fleet jumps.
crisis.jump.newCaprica: New Caprica phase: before Galactica returns this still advances the track (Auto-Jump brings Galactica back). Afterwards ignore it and resolve the Evacuation icon instead: move the top Prepared civilian ship to a viper launch area.
crisis.jump.mutineer: The Mutineer must draw a Mutiny card when resolving this icon on their Crisis.
crisis.jump.caprica: Cylon using the Caprica location: the jump icon is not ignored.
crisis.fleet.title: Placing on the Cylon Fleet board
crisis.fleet.inSupply: In supply? Roll a die (may be modified) and place it in the Cylon space area with that number.
crisis.fleet.supplyEmpty: Supply empty? Take the highest-numbered Cylon space area holding that ship and move all ships there to the matching main-board area. Not on the fleet board at all → nothing moves.
crisis.fleet.civilians: Civilian ship icons → the CAG places that many civilian ships on the main board (empty areas first).
crisis.fleet.autoAttack: Auto Attack → move all fleet-board ships to the matching main areas and reset the marker.
crisis.fleet.never: Ships on the Cylon Fleet board never activate or launch.
crisis.fleet.outOfSupply: When an effect places Cylon ships on the main board and the supply is out: take them from the lowest-numbered fleet area (no Pursuit advance).
crisis.fleet.onJump: On a jump, all Cylon ships move to the matching fleet areas (basestar damage discarded); civilian ships stay.
crisis.fleet.location: Cylon Fleet location “launch 2 raiders + 1 heavy raider” does not touch the fleet board.
crisis.attack.title: Cylon Attack cards
crisis.attack.setup: Setup: place the new ships shown (existing ships stay).
crisis.attack.special: Special rule applies; discard the card unless it says to keep it in play.
crisis.attack.outOfTokens: Out of tokens? The current player chooses which to place.
crisis.newCaprica.title: New Caprica activations
crisis.newCaprica.before: Before Galactica returns: ignore every activation except Occupation Forces, and anything that places, moves or damages ships.
crisis.newCaprica.forces: Occupation Forces: one at the Shipyard leaves and destroys a Locked (else Prepared) civilian ship; the rest move 1 right; none on the track → place one under Occupation Authority.
crisis.newCaprica.separate: Occupation Forces and Centurions are separate and never move each other.
crisis.placement.title: Ship placement reminders
crisis.placement.civilian: A civilian ship to place with no area given: the Admiral chooses any area.
crisis.placement.civilianFleet: A civilian ship to place with no area given: the CAG places it in an area without a civilian ship if possible.
crisis.placement.heavy: A heavy raider that can’t become a Centurion (no tokens) stays in space.
crisis.placement.cylonPlayers: Cylon players may ignore Crisis effects unless they say they apply to Cylons.
crisis.placement.superCrisis: Super Crisis cards ignore character abilities and anything that affects “Crisis cards”.
reckless.daybreak.intro: A Skill card marked Reckless is played before cards are added and makes the check Reckless. After the Skill Check Abilities are resolved:
reckless.daybreak.step2: Strength 0? Draw 1 more Treachery card, resolve both cards’ Skill Check Abilities (duplicates allowed), then discard both - they don’t count toward the total.
reckless.summary: A Skill card marked Reckless is played before cards are added and makes the check Reckless. Treachery cards with a “Reckless Skill Check” ability only trigger when revealed in a Reckless check.
reckless.seq.begins: Check begins - auto pass/fail effects resolve.
reckless.seq.play: Play the Reckless card (a “before cards are added” ability). Max one per check; not after “Restore Order”, and “Restore Order” can’t follow it.
reckless.seq.add: Add 2 Destiny cards, then players add cards (current player last).
reckless.seq.abilitiesTreachery: Resolve Skill Check Abilities. “Reckless Skill Check” Treachery abilities trigger now, only because the check is Reckless.
reckless.seq.daybreakDraw: Reckless draw: show 1 Treachery card. Strength 0 → draw a second, resolve both abilities, discard both. Otherwise discard it, no effect.
reckless.seq.consequence: Consequence (Skill Check Ability outcome), total the strength, resolve pass / partial / fail.
exec.resurrectionNewCaprica: the Resurrection Ship (or the Medical Center during the New Caprica phase before Galactica returns)
exec.needsExpansion: Execution comes with Pegasus or Exodus. Enable one in {setup} to see the procedure.
exec.done.title: Execution resolved
exec.pick.title: Who is being executed?
exec.pick.noPlayers: No players set up. {setup} or read the general procedure in the {rulebook}.
exec.step1.title: Step 1 · Everyone
exec.step1.discardHand: Discard your entire hand of Skill cards.
exec.step1.quorum: Discard Quorum cards attached to your character (e.g. Assign Vice President, not the President’s hand).
exec.step1.quorumDaybreak: Discard Quorum cards attached to your character (e.g. Assign Vice President, not the President’s hand), all Mutiny cards and your Miracle token.
exec.step1.currentPlayer: If you were the current player: finish the execution, then skip your remaining move, action and Crisis steps.
exec.step1.ally: If an Ally executed you, replace that Ally afterwards as if its location was damaged.
exec.step2.title: Step 2 · Is the player human or Cylon?
exec.step2.revealed: Already a revealed Cylon - Cylon procedure below.
exec.step2.check: The executed player checks their Loyalty cards.
exec.step2.cylonHint: Has a “You Are a Cylon” card
exec.hidden.title: Step 3 · Hidden Cylon revealed
exec.hidden.reveal: Reveal one “You Are a Cylon” card; keep the others face down. Do not take its action.
exec.trauma: Take 1 Trauma token from the pile (not the Mood Pool).
exec.hidden.discard: Discard Skill cards down to 3 (already 0 after Step 1).
exec.hidden.titles: Lose all titles to the highest in each line of succession - Quorum hand, nukes etc. go with them.
exec.moveTo: Move to {place}. A piloted ship returns to the Reserves.
exec.hidden.mutineer: If you were the Mutineer, hand the Mutineer card face up to a human player of your choice.
exec.hidden.loyaltyOverlay: If the distance is 6 or less: look at your other Loyalty cards and pass them all face down to one human player.
exec.hidden.loyalty: Keep other Loyalty cards hidden; they can be passed on later from the Resurrection Ship.
exec.hidden.fromNow: From now on follow the rules for revealed Cylons (no Crisis card on your turn).
exec.hidden.doneTitles: Titles were passed down the lines of succession.
exec.revealed.title: Step 3 · Revealed Cylon
exec.human.title: Step 3 · Human executed
exec.human.finalFive: Resolve any Final Five card’s execution text, then remove it from the game.
exec.human.returnTrauma: Return {name} to the box and discard your Trauma tokens.
exec.human.boomerIfBefore: If the Sleeper Agent phase hasn’t happened yet (you were Boomer): draw 1 new Loyalty card.
exec.human.boomerBefore: You were Boomer before the Sleeper Agent phase: draw 1 new Loyalty card.
exec.human.choose: Choose a new character below (any type; no alternates of characters in play, no Cylon Leaders).
exec.human.start: Start at the character’s setup location (Hangar Deck if unavailable).
exec.human.startNewCaprica: Start at the character’s setup location (Hangar Deck if unavailable); on New Caprica before Galactica returns, Resistance HQ.
exec.human.exodusDraw: Shuffle 1 card from the “Not a Cylon” pile into the Loyalty deck and draw 1 Loyalty card.
exec.human.exodusBoomerBefore: (Executed Boomer before the Sleeper Agent phase: draw 1 more.)
exec.human.exodusBoomerIf: (Executed Boomer: draw 1 more if the Sleeper Agent phase hasn’t happened yet.)
exec.human.titles: Titles you held go to the first in line, including your new character. Other titles stay put.
exec.human.mutineer: If you were the Mutineer, your new character receives the Mutineer card again (face up).
exec.human.traumaIonian: Draw 3 new Trauma tokens (replace any Disaster drawn).
exec.human.none: No characters left - the humans lose!
exec.human.done: {old} was executed and is now playing {now}.
exec.human.doneTitles: Titles were redistributed - check the Titles tab.
exec.footnote: A new character can’t use an ability on the effect that executed the previous one, but can on what happens right after.
exec.note.boomerShuffle: Shuffle 1 “Not a Cylon” card into the Loyalty deck.
exec.note.boomerDetention: (Detention if the executed character was on New Caprica)
exec.note.helo: Starts “Stranded” even though it is not the start of the game.
exec.note.apollo: Starts in a viper from the Reserves (Hangar Deck if none).
exec.note.gaiusBefore: Before the Sleeper Agent phase: shuffle 1 “Not a Cylon” card into the Loyalty deck and draw 1 Loyalty card.
exec.note.gaiusAfter: After the Sleeper Agent phase: may not use Cylon Detector.
exec.note.samuel: Skip Receive Skills on the first turn (“Starts on the Bench”).
exec.sleeper.question: Has the Sleeper Agent phase happened?
quick.reckless.title: Reckless
quick.reckless.onePerCheck: Only one Reckless card per check. Not combinable with “Restore Order” either way.
quick.sca.title: Skill Check Abilities
quick.sca.trigger: Cards with the Skill Check Ability icon only trigger when revealed in a check. Duplicates by name resolve once.
quick.sca.order: Current player picks the order. A Crisis “consequence” (icon outcome) triggers if at least one such card was played.
quick.sca.treachery: Human players can’t use Treachery text otherwise; anyone may put them in checks. Treachery always counts negative.
quick.reveal.title: Revealing as a Cylon
quick.reveal.action: Reveal as your action and do the card’s action (not if in the Brig).
quick.reveal.actionExecution: Reveal as your action and do the card’s action (not if in the Brig or executed).
quick.reveal.discard: Discard Skill cards down to 3; discard attached Quorum cards.
quick.reveal.discardDaybreak: Discard Skill cards down to 3; discard attached Quorum cards, Mutiny cards, Miracle token.
quick.reveal.titles: Lose titles down the lines of succession.
quick.reveal.resurrection: Move to the Resurrection Ship. Draw a Super Crisis card.
quick.reveal.loyaltyOverlay: Distance 6 or less: pass your other Loyalty cards face down to one human player.
quick.reveal.loyalty: Keep other Loyalty cards hidden; pass them on from the Resurrection Ship.
quick.reveal.mutineer: If you were the Mutineer, give the Mutineer card to a human player.
quick.reveal.ownTurn: If you revealed on your own turn, your turn ends, no Crisis.
quick.reveal.fromNow: From now on, play Cylon turns (see “Cylon player’s turn”).
quick.cylonTurn.title: Cylon player’s turn
quick.sleeper.title: Sleeper Agent phase
quick.sleeper.deal: At the objective card’s distance: deal 1 Loyalty card to every player, revealed Cylons included. Boomer gets 2.
quick.sleeper.dealLeader: At the objective card’s distance: deal 1 Loyalty card to every player except the Cylon Leader, revealed Cylons included. Boomer gets 2.
quick.sleeper.revealedOverlay: Revealed Cylons look at theirs and pass them face down to one human.
quick.sleeper.revealed: Revealed Cylons keep theirs secret (can pass them via the Resurrection Ship).
quick.sleeper.motives: The Cylon Leader gets 2 more Motive cards.
quick.sleeper.mutineer: Mutineer still in the deck afterwards → current player picks a human to draw 1 more.
quick.brig.title: Brig & Sickbay
quick.brig.noMoving: Brig: no moving out unless the Brig check is passed or an effect names the Brig. Max 1 card into checks.
quick.brig.choose: When choosing who goes to the Brig/Sickbay you must pick someone who can actually move there, if possible.
quick.brig.admiral: Admiral sent to the Brig loses the title.
quick.brig.adminCag: Admiral/CAG sent to the Brig loses the title.
quick.brig.movement: Movement actions may still be used in the Brig.
quick.trauma.title: Trauma tokens
quick.miracle.title: Miracle tokens
quick.miracle.cost: Once-per-game abilities now cost 1 Miracle token and can be used again later.
quick.miracle.limit: Max 1 token per player (support Baltar: 3). Tokens can’t be traded.
quick.mutiny.title: Mutiny cards
quick.mutiny.limit: Limit 1 (the Mutineer: 2). Going over: go to the Brig, then discard down to the limit.
quick.mutiny.cylons: Revealed Cylons can’t hold, play or be targeted to draw Mutiny cards.
quick.mutiny.perTurn: Max one Mutiny card per turn from choosing to discard Treachery.
quick.infiltrate.title: Infiltrating
quick.infiltrate.become: Action at “Human Fleet”: become an Infiltrator, treated as a human player.
quick.infiltrate.limits: Draw 1 extra Skill card; max 2 cards into checks; cannot hold titles.
quick.infiltrate.end: Action: end Infiltration and move to the Resurrection Ship (discard to 3 if leaving the Brig).
quick.nukes.title: Nukes
quick.nukes.start: Admiral starts with 2. Used nukes are removed from the game.
quick.nukes.startExodus: Admiral starts with 2. Used nukes are discarded and can be regained (3rd token in the box).
quick.nukes.rollFleet: Targets a whole space area: 1-2 basestar damaged twice · 3-6 basestar destroyed · 7 + 3 raiders · 8 everything.
quick.jump.title: Jumping
quick.jump.ftl: FTL Control: roll first; 6 or less → lose the population on the current jump space.
quick.jump.mission: Follow the Active Mission space instructions.
quick.jump.shipsFleet: Cylon ships to the matching fleet-board areas; vipers to the Reserves; civilians stay.
quick.jump.ships: Remove all ships from the board (Centurions stay); pilots to the Hangar Deck.
quick.jump.assault: Assault raptors may stay in space.
quick.jump.destinations: Admiral draws 2 Destinations, picks 1 secretly, the other goes to the bottom.
quick.jump.resolve: Resolve it, add the distance, check the objective card, reset the jump track.
quick.limits.title: Hand limits & secrecy
quick.limits.hand: End of every turn: discard down to 10 Skill cards.
quick.limits.handQuorum: End of every turn: discard down to 10 Skill cards (and 10 Quorum cards for the President).
quick.limits.talk: No exact card strengths or types in talk; “a lot/a little”, “good/bad” are fine.
quick.limits.zero: Resource at 0: humans have until the end of the turn to fix it.
quick.cylonTurn.receiveAny: Receive Skills: draw {count} Skill cards of any type{noSympathizer}.
quick.cylonTurn.receiveDifferent: Receive Skills: draw {count} Skill cards of different types{noSympathizer}.
quick.cylonTurn.receiveResurrection: On the Resurrection Ship: draw only 1.
quick.cylonTurn.receiveResurrectionMedic: On the Resurrection Ship or in the Medical Center: draw only 1.
quick.cylonTurn.receiveLeader: A Cylon Leader draws from their own skill set.
quick.cylonTurn.movement: Movement: move to another Cylon location (discard 1 Skill card to change ship){ability}.
quick.cylonTurn.action: Action: take one action, usually your location’s.
quick.cylonTurn.noCrisis: No Crisis step and no Activate Cylon Ships step.
quick.cylonTurn.jump: Prepare for Jump: only if you resolved a Crisis this turn (e.g. at Caprica).
quick.cylonTurn.jumpCounts: Its jump icon advances the fleet token.
quick.cylonTurn.jumpIgnored: In the base game its jump icon is ignored.
quick.cylonTurn.cannot.title: Cylon players cannot
quick.cylonTurn.cannot.titles: hold titles, or be sent to the Brig{detention} or Sickbay{airlock};
quick.cylonTurn.cannot.use: use Skill card text{treachery}, Quorum cards{mutiny} or their old character’s abilities{leaders};
quick.cylonTurn.cannot.cards: add more than 1 card to a Skill check.
quick.cylonTurn.ignoreCrisis: They may ignore Crisis effects unless the card says it affects Cylon players.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.title: Cylon locations
quick.cylonTurn.locations.caprica: Caprica: play 1 of your Super Crisis cards, or draw 2 Crisis cards, resolve 1 and put the other on the bottom (no Activate Cylon Ships step).
quick.cylonTurn.locations.fleet: Cylon Fleet: activate all Cylon ships of one type, or launch 2 raiders and 1 heavy raider from each basestar on the main board.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.humanFleet: Human Fleet: look at the top Crisis or Destination card, put it on top or bottom, then draw 2 Skill cards.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.resurrection: Resurrection Ship: draw only 1 Skill card in Receive Skills. Action: draw 1 Super Crisis card.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.bridge: Basestar Bridge: choose 2 different: the CAG places a civilian ship · roll 1-3 jump track −1, 4-8 Pursuit +1 · place a basestar or 3 raiders in one Cylon Fleet area · roll, and if lower than the raiders on the main board, draw 2 Galactica damage tokens and resolve 1.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.authority: Occupation Authority: activate 1 Occupation Force, then place 1 here.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.canyon: Breeder’s Canyon: draw and resolve the top Crisis; skip this turn’s Prepare for Jump step.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.shipyard: Shipyard: look at the top Locked civilian ship and put it on top or bottom of the stack.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.detain: Detain a Human: in a location with a human and an Occupation Force, roll: 1-3 Detention, 4-7 Medical Center, 8 no effect.
quick.cylonTurn.locations.board: Use the actions printed on your board’s Cylon locations.
quick.trauma.want: Humans want benevolent tokens, Cylons antagonistic ones. Keep your tokens face down.
quick.trauma.keep: Keep any benevolent or antagonistic token.
quick.trauma.revealDisaster: Reveal a disaster token: a human player is executed; a Cylon player draws 2 more (repeat for further disasters) and keeps the rest.
quick.trauma.return: Return disaster tokens to the pool and mix it.
quick.trauma.startOfTurn: Start of your turn on a location with a token (e.g. Brig, Sickbay): take it and replace it from the pool.
quick.trauma.noDisasters: No disaster tokens in this variant.
quick.trauma.brigSickbay: Draw 1 when sent to the Brig or Sickbay; a hidden Cylon who is executed draws 1.
quick.trauma.allies: Allies are resolved with a token drawn from the Mood Pool.
quick.trauma.distance8: At distance 8 everyone reveals tokens and scores them (Trauma phase).
